Hi Jordan,

A colleague at Modern Treasury mentioned that you’re celebrating the company’s eighth birthday while reflecting on how payments infrastructure is evolving and what it means when money moves from A to B. It sounds like you’re deep in the challenges of building reliable, scalable payment flows.

I’d love to explore how we can help your operations team automate those manual, reconciliation‑heavy processes so you can focus on innovation rather than back‑office toil.

Best regards,
Zamp
